hero.title: From the springs of the Quran… to new horizons
hero.sub: A complete knowledge platform reviving the Quranic sciences in the spirit of our time
hero.sec2Title: One city, four tributaries of knowledge
hero.sec2Sub: Walk through the city and meet its buildings before you step inside
hero.scroll: Scroll down to enter the world of Rawafed
hero.titleA: From the springs of the Quran…

reciters.name: Reciters
reciters.line: Voices of reciters across generations, in one hall
body: The Reciters Hall is the heart of the city: a calm space to listen to masterful recitations and get to know the reciters and their schools.
Choose a reciter and a surah, and listen in a hall that opens onto the sea.
features: Lives and schools of the reciters

library.name: Library
library.line: Books of tafsir and Quranic sciences at your fingertips
body: A digital library gathering the major works of tafsir and Quranic sciences, organised by topic, surah and author.
Search the verses and go straight to what the commentators said.

learning.name: Learning
learning.line: Learning paths in tajweed, memorisation and reflection
body: Interactive classes and step-by-step paths, from the rules of tajweed to mastering recitation and memorisation.
Short lessons, voice exercises and progress tracking, one step at a time.

community.name: Community
community.line: Circles and gatherings that bring the people of the Quran together
body: Gatherings for discussion and circles for recitation and study, where you meet teachers and students from everywhere.
Join a circle, take part in a gathering, or start your own.

old.name: First Reciter
old.bio: A master reciter of the first generation, known for his calm delivery and measured pauses.
old.credit: Recited by Sheikh Mahmoud Khalil Al-Hussary

young.name: Second Reciter
young.bio: A young reciter who combines precise tajweed with a beautiful voice.
